x: Also on the programme were some club handicaps and these resulted as under:— 100 yards.—Heat 1: Holtum (8), Gordon (3).
We had Gordon and R. Morrell in the senior 100 yds., with Ian Badiali and Don Maclean as our 220 men, but they failed to score a win and Mac’s finishing leap was something to see!

In the final event, the 4 x 110 yds. relay, our team of Benstead, Gordon, Robinson and Walden, were 3rd to S.L.H. and Mitcham, and the final points in the match were :—1, Belgrave H. and S.L.H., 25 each ; Mitcham A.C., 24 ; Sutton and Cheam H., 16, and Polytechnic H., 15.
In the 440 yards Dudley Gordon finished 2nd; John Davis won the 880 yards with George Davidson fourth. The two miles was won by Dave Baulch with Don Stroud 2nd and Dave Hooper 3rd.
Jack Brown shook off all opposition except the great Gordon in the three miles dowing an excellent time of 14m. 48s. The result of all these efforts was a win for the Bels. by a clear 10 points.

Experience has been given to newcomers to this event, which will help us next April, and now that S.L.H. have lost the great Gordon and we can improve on our team by the inclusion of Davies and Hallowell, it can be hoped that last year's 5th position in the National Relay can be bettered by at least 4 places.

The race was won by Linford (T.V.H.) for Lensbury in 2m.0.8s., on a five laps to the mile grass track. Dudley Gordon was unlucky not to win the 440, losing by inches, after leading all the way - he also doubled up in the 100yds.
